shared_elements: multiple small figures scattered across a single surface
justification: Both surfaces present an assortment of small schematic figures, including quadruped-like animals, stick-limbed anthropomorphs and circular/oval motifs, distributed over a single field rather than forming a unified scene. But the specifics diverge sharply: A shows registers with recognisable profile carnivores, birds and reptiles arranged in ordered bands around a large pendant-like carved panel, while B shows loose, ambiguous painted signs — paired concentric rings, arcs, comb-forms and splayed anthropomorphs — with no register structure or identifiable species, so the correspondences are of the generic sort any two traditions could reach independently.
